_about: Space buddy adventures: short stories where the child practises what they learned in the feelings leaves. Copy an adventure to make a new one. Step types: talk ('say' + 'next'), choice ('choices'), your words ('ideas' + 'listen' + 'otherwise'), feelings ('feelings': true), and the end ('end': true). A line that starts with a cast id and ':' (like 'robo: Beep!') is said by that character. {name} = the child, {buddy} = the buddy. Run 'npm test' to check. See CONTENT_GUIDE.md section 14 (it has a template).

adventures.title: The Sad Little Robot
adventures.about: A little robot on Planet Bolt looks sad. Can you help?

say: {name}, look! We landed on Planet Bolt. 🪐
There's a little robot sitting all alone.
robo: Beep… boop… 😔
Its lights are dim and blue, and it's looking down at the ground.
How do you think the robot feels?

choices.reply: Yes! Looking down and dim blue lights can mean sad. Great noticing! 🔍
Hmm, happy robots usually bounce, and their lights shine bright. This robot is looking down. Look again! 👀
Good guess! But angry robots might stomp and flash red. This one is quiet and looking down. Try again! 👀

say: What can we do when someone looks sad?

choices.reply: Yes! Asking is a kind way to start. 💜
Hmm, laughing might make the robot feel worse. 💜 What else could we do?
We could… but the robot might feel even more alone. 💜 Let's try something else.

say: What could you say to the robot?
ideas: Hi! Do you want to play?

listen.reply: Hmm, that might make the robot even sadder. 💜 What's a kind thing to say?
So friendly! 😊 A friendly hello helps a lot.

steps.otherwise: That's your own idea! 🌟 You were brave to talk to someone new.

say: robo: Beep! You… you talked to me! 🤖
robo: I lost my favourite bolt. It's shiny and gold. I can't find it anywhere. 😢
Oh no! That's why Robo is sad.
How can we help Robo?

choices.reply: Great idea! Helping is a super kind thing to do. 💪
Hmm, the bolt is special to Robo. 💜 Things we love matter, even small things. What else could we do?
Crying is OK. It helps feelings come out. 💜 Let's try another way.

say: Where should we look? 🔍

choices.reply: Let's look… not here! But wait… something shiny! ✨
Let's look… there it is! ✨

say: You found the golden bolt! 🔩
robo: BEEP BEEP! My bolt! Thank you, thank you! 🤖💛
Look! Robo's lights turned bright yellow, and Robo is spinning around!
How does Robo feel now?

choices.reply: Yes! Bright lights and spinning mean happy! 🎉
Hmm, look at Robo: bright lights, spinning around… Is that sad? Look again! 👀
Scared robots might hide. Robo is spinning and shining! Try again! 👀

say: How do YOU feel when you help a friend?

feelingReplies.happy: Me too! Helping makes my antennas glow! 😊
feelingReplies.calm: Helping can feel warm and calm. 😌
feelingReplies.*: All feelings are OK! 💜 Thank you for telling me.

say: robo: You're my new friend, {name}! Beep boop! 🤖💜
You noticed Robo was sad, asked if Robo was OK, and helped. That's what a great friend does! 🌟

adventures.title: Meteor Mess
adventures.about: My tower fell down and I'm SO angry! Help me calm down.

say: Look, {name}! I built a giant moon-block tower! 🏰
It took me ALL morning. It's my best tower ever!
luna: Meow! *zoom zoom* 🐱💨
CRASH! 💥 Luna the space cat ran into my tower, and it fell down!
Grrr! My tower! 😠
How do you think I feel right now?

choices.reply: Yes. I feel ANGRY! My face is hot and my hands are tight. 😠
Hmm, look at my face: my eyebrows are down and my mouth is tight. Is that happy? 👀
Not sleepy! My eyes are wide open and I want to stomp! Look again. 👀

say: When I'm angry, my body feels hot, like a volcano. 🌋
What could I do to calm down?

choices.reply: Great idea! Let's do it together.
Hmm, kicking could hurt me or break things. 💜 Angry is OK, but hurting is not. What else?
Yelling might scare Luna. 💜 Let's find a calmer way first.
Yes! Counting helps my brain slow down. And breathing too!

say: Let's breathe together. Breathe IN slowly through your nose… 1… 2… 3… 🌬️
Now breathe OUT through your mouth, like blowing out a candle… 1… 2… 3… 💨
Phew. I feel calmer now. 😌 My face isn't hot anymore.
Luna is hiding behind a rock. She looks worried. 🐱
What could I say to Luna?
ideas: I feel angry because my tower fell.

listen.reply: Hmm, that might hurt Luna's feelings. 💜 She didn't mean to. What else could I say?
Yes! Saying how I feel, with words, is SO much better than yelling. 🌟
Good one! That tells Luna what I need, in a kind way. 💜

steps.otherwise: That's a calm way to say it! 🌟

say: luna: Meow… I'm sorry I knocked down your tower. I was zooming too fast. 😿
Luna said sorry! What could I say back?

choices.text: That's OK. Let's build it together! 🧱
choices.reply: Yes! Building is more fun together! 🎉
Hmm, Luna said sorry and feels bad. 💜 Could we forgive her?
That's OK too, if you need a minute. 💜 But Luna might like to hear something kind. Try again?

say: We built an even BIGGER tower together! 🏰
luna: Purrr! Teamwork! 🐱💜
What helps YOU calm down when you're angry?

listen.reply: That's a great idea! Remember it for next time. 🌟

steps.otherwise: That's a great idea! Everyone has their own way to calm down. 🌟

say: You helped me calm down, use my words, and forgive Luna. 🌋➡️😌
Angry feelings are OK. What we DO with them matters. You're a calm-down champion, {name}! 🏆

adventures.title: The Rocket Show
adventures.about: A dark tunnel, then a LOUD rocket show. Let's stay calm together!

say: Tonight is the big Rocket Show, {name}! 🎆
But first we have to walk through the Moon Tunnel. 🌙
It's very dark in here…
pip: Um… I don't want to go in there. 😨 It's so dark…
That's Pip, a little alien. Pip is shaking.
How do you think Pip feels?

choices.reply: Yes. Shaking and not wanting to go in can mean scared. 😨
Hmm, Pip is shaking and doesn't want to go in. Is that bored? Look again. 👀
Pip isn't laughing or making silly faces. Pip is shaking. Try again! 👀

say: What could help Pip?

choices.text: Hold hands and use a flashlight 🔦
choices.reply: Great idea! Light and a friend make dark places less scary. 🤝
Hmm, that might make Pip feel worse. 💜 Everyone gets scared sometimes. What else could help?
Pip might feel even more scared alone. 💜 Let's stay together.

say: Click! 🔦 We hold hands and walk together.
pip: It's not so scary with you! Thank you! 👾💜
We made it to the Rocket Show! 🎆
BOOM! 💥 BANG! 💥 The rockets are SO loud, the lights are flashing, and there are SO many people! 📢
Oh no… I'm covering my ears. Everything is too much for me. 🙉
What is happening to me?

choices.text: It's too much: too loud and too bright 🙉
choices.reply: Yes. When there's too much noise and light, my brain gets overloaded. That's called overstimulation. 🙉
Hmm, I'm covering my ears and squeezing my eyes. Is that happy? Look again. 👀
I'm not sleepy… I'm covering my ears because it's so loud! Try again! 👀

say: What can help me?

choices.reply: Ahh, that's better! Headphones make the noise smaller. 🎧
Good idea! A quiet spot gives my brain a rest. 🤫
Hmm, more noise would make it worse. 💜 What could make it quieter?

say: I should tell a grown-up how I feel. What could I say?
ideas: It's too loud. I need a break.

listen.reply: Perfect! Saying what you need helps grown-ups help you. 🌟
Hmm, but I'm NOT fine right now. 💜 It's OK to say what's wrong. What could I say?

steps.otherwise: That's a good way to ask for help! 🌟

say: We went to the quiet tent. It's calm and cozy here. ⛺
From here, the rockets look pretty, and they're not too loud. 🎆😌
pip: I like the quiet tent too! 👾
How do YOU feel in quiet places?

feelingReplies.calm: Me too! Quiet places are cozy. 😌
feelingReplies.tired: Quiet places are great for resting. 😴

say: You helped Pip when Pip was scared, and you helped me when everything was too much. 🌟
It's OK to need a break. Taking care of yourself is SMART, {name}! 🧠💜

adventures.title: New Kid on the Space Station
adventures.about: Your first day at Space School! New places, new kids, a new friend.

say: Today is your FIRST day at Space School, {name}! 🛰️
Everything is new: new rooms, new kids, new rules.
How do you feel on a first day?

feelingReplies.scared: Lots of kids feel scared on a first day. That's OK! 💜
feelingReplies.excited: Woohoo! New things can be exciting! 🤩
feelingReplies.overwhelmed: New places can be too much. It's OK to take a break. 💜
feelingReplies.*: All feelings are OK on a first day! 💜

say: Here's a tip for new places: find a grown-up who can help.
kai: Hello! I'm Captain Kai, your teacher. 🧑‍🚀 Welcome!
What could you ask Captain Kai?

listen.reply: Great question! Asking questions makes new places less scary. 🌟

steps.otherwise: Good question! Grown-ups are happy to help. 😊

say: kai: Great question! I'll show you around. At break time, you can play with the other kids. 😊
It's break time! Some kids are playing star-ball. ⚽🌟
A girl named Ava looks at you, smiles, and waves. 👋
What does Ava's body say?

choices.reply: Yes! A smile and a wave usually mean “Hi! You're welcome here!” 👋
Hmm, Ava is smiling and waving. People who want you to go away don't usually smile and wave. Look again! 👀
Ava's smiling! Smiles usually mean happy or friendly. Try again! 👀

say: What could you say to join the game?

listen.reply: Hmm, grabbing the ball might upset the others. 💜 What could you SAY first?
Perfect! That's a great way to join. 🌟

steps.otherwise: Nice! Being friendly is a great start. 😊

say: ava: Sure! I'm Ava. What do you like?
Tell Ava something you love!

listen.reply: Ooh, cool! Sharing what you love helps people get to know you. 🌟

say: You tell Ava LOTS of facts about the thing you love. 🤓
After a while, Ava looks at the ball, then at the other kids, and says “Mm-hm…”
What might Ava's body be saying now?

choices.text: Maybe she wants to play now ⚽
choices.reply: Good noticing! Looking away and “Mm-hm” can mean someone wants to do something else. 👀
Hmm, Ava is looking at the ball and the other kids. What could that mean? Look again. 👀
Ava isn't frowning or stomping. She's just looking at the game. Try again! 👀

say: You can ask Ava about HER! What could you ask?
ideas: Do you want to play star-ball now?

listen.reply: Yes! Asking about the other person is what good friends do. 💜

steps.otherwise: Nice! Taking turns talking makes friends happy. 💜

say: ava: I like star-ball AND dinosaurs! Let's play together! ⚽🦖
You did it, {name}! You asked for help, read Ava's body language, joined a game, shared what you love, AND took turns talking. 🌟
That's how new friendships start! 🤝
